name: 陳秀慧
objective: This course introduces the fundamental principles and applications of analytical chemistry. Topics include analytical processes, sampling and sample preparation, errors and statistical treatment of data, hypothesis testing, gravimetric analysis, chemical equilibria, electrochemical principles, interactions between light and matter, molecular characterization, and interpretation of analytical results. Common analytical reagents, instrumentation, and laboratory operations are also discussed. Emphasis is placed on obtaining representative samples, developing reliable analytical methods, evaluating data quality, and applying analytical chemistry to practical problems in environmental, materials, biological, and food sciences.
課程進度(1-16週):
W1. The Nature of Analytical Chemistry
W2.  Chemicals, Apparatus, and Unit Operations of Analytical Chemistry
W3. Using Spreadsheets in Analytical Chemistry
W4.. Calculations Used in Analytical Chemistry
W5. Errors in Chemical Analyses
W6.. Random Errors in Chemical Analysis
W7. Statistical Data Treatment and Evaluation
W8. Sampling, Standardization, and Calibration
W9. Aqueous Solutions and Chemical Equilibria
W10. Effect of Electrolytes on Chemical Equilibria
W11. Solving Equilibrium Problems for Complex Systems
W12. Gravimetric Methods of Analysis
W13. Titrations in Analytical Chemistry 
W14. Principles of Neutralization Titrations
W15. Complex Acid/Bases Systems
W16. Applications of Neutralization Titrations
W17. Complexation and Precipitation Reactions and Titrations
W18. Final Exam
